goal: Return standard JSON-RPC 2.0 error payloads with HTTP 200 for malformed requests instead of HTTP errors
Prevent debug builds from crashing on malformed authenticated JSON-RPC 2.0 requests
agreement: Concept approval after verifying malformed requests return HTTP 200 with an error object (fametrano)
Unresolved objection: batches and single requests handle invalid notifications inconsistently (ryanofsky)
Suggested determining notifications during request parsing rather than during execution (fametrano)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it corrects JSON-RPC 2.0 specification compliance for malformed request errors
Resolves an assertion failure that crashes debug builds on malformed authenticated requests
